## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This one-fascicle text is the structural-outline (*kē* 科) by [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì of [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *[Wǔ jiào zhāng 五教章](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0074)* (T1866). It serves as the navigational map for Shīhuì's own *[Fù gǔ jì 復古記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0078)* (X998) and, by extension, for the parent text of Fǎzàng. The hierarchical heading-format makes the conceptual structure of Fǎzàng's doxographical schema accessible at a glance.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1145 – 1170) reflects [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì's mature scholarly period at the Yùfēng 玉峯 monastery. As with all *kē* outlines, the work's primary function is pedagogical and navigational: it provides the structural skeleton of the larger treatise, enabling students to track its doctrinal articulation. Shīhuì's particular *kē* of the *Wǔ jiào zhāng* preserves his own reading of the work's structure — sometimes differing in minor structural divisions from [道亭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E4%BA%AD) Dàotíng's earlier reading.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* 續藏經 (X997) collection.
